protocol.percentile: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; all HTTP samples, plus separate success/429/503 series
protocol.deployment: one real Uvicorn process, limit-concurrency 32, no-proxy-headers, no-server-header; default AbuseController quotas and slots unchanged
protocol.isolation: fresh UUID schema per scenario on dedicated PostgreSQL16 at 127.0.0.1:55440/smartir_validation; API restarted once after fixture provisioning, before measurement

acceptance.interpretation: 429 are expected admission control, not accepted event loss; failed criteria must be reported. No production SLO or human MTTD/MTTR inference.

environment.resources: CPU/RSS not sampled by this HTTP runner; no estimates
